description: This file implements a React component called CustomersClient for managing customers within a shop. It provides functionality such as listing customers, searching, pagination, creating new customers via a form and modal, and linking to customer details. It interacts with external APIs and UI components.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of customers for the given shopId from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the customer creation form data for required fields, email format, and duplicate IDs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new customer, including optimistic update, API call, error handling, and UI updates.
